verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins is a law firm offering legal services, glossaries, and document-generator resources (LathamDrive). It is not an AI agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client, so plugging MCP servers into it is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agentic or tool-consuming capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
